author: Arnav
problem: A fixed-width bank record is split into fields; layout maps each field name to its (first, last) column, with columns numbered from 1. Return a dict of each field's text with the padding spaces removed.
bug_description: Slices line[first - 1:last - 1], converting both column numbers to 0-based, so the last column of every field is cut off (hidden when that column is padding).

comments.accurate: Pulls each named field out of the record by its column range and trims the padding
comments.wrong_behavior: Converts each field's first and last column to 0-based offsets and slices between them
comments.wrong_location: Column slicing verified; strip() may also remove spaces that belong to the field
